laws.rule: Atlas saharien Cultural Park, named Gueltat Es Stel and Messaâd access points: article 30 of Executive Decree 14-04 directs park entry through surveillance/control posts. Tourist visits within the park's designated protection zones must be organised through a public body or licensed tourism agency and accompanied by a park-appointed guide, approximately one guide per ten visitors (article 37). Agency tourist activities in those zones need prior park-office authorisation (article 38). These conditions do not impose a guide on all travel elsewhere in the wilaya.

Atlas saharien Cultural Park protection zones: do not collect cultural or natural objects, take minerals or fossils without permission, or damage wild plants. Article 39 prohibits wetting or taking moulds of rock-art stations, scratching, graffiti and detaching the rock surface. Organised professional film/photo activity needs prior culture-ministry authorisation and a park-office agreement under article 35; ordinary sightseeing admission is not such authorisation.

sources.title: JORADP no. 3, 22 January 2014: Executive Decree 14-04
sources.supports: Read directly: Atlas saharien Cultural Park boundaries, named checkpoints, organised protected-zone visits and guide requirement (arts 3, 30, 35 to 39). Published instrument read directly, not a current consolidated code.

local-law.note: Park zones and named access locations only. The 2014 text predates new wilaya boundaries: Ouled Djellal is assigned to its present wilaya rather than copying the old Biskra label. Current gate operation, live zoning and later amendments not yet checked; obtain park confirmation before an expedition. No entry-fee amount reproduced.
